prose: A Hacker News discussion links to a Reddit post claiming a hacker reverse-engineered a Samsung TV and found its on-board AI listening features tied to an OpenAI account that was subsequently suspended. Details beyond the headline are not verifiable from the available source.
highlights: A Reddit post (via Hacker News) claims a reverse-engineered Samsung TV exposed on-board AI listening tied to an OpenAI account.
The OpenAI account involved was reportedly suspended.
Technical specifics cannot be confirmed from the blocked source.
basis: Basis: feed title only; the Reddit source was bot-blocked, so no article text was available.
